changes: Every routing mutation needs its preview and fingerprint: the earlier single-interface request and any request without mode, interfaces and fingerprint are refused (preview_required); removing a network's routing needs ?based_on= and records the previous policy. Regression tests prove a shared set survives each bypass.
scd treats an absent policy table as no policy: one mapped interface keeps working, several refuse, every other method is unaffected (schema rolled back under a running scd).

0155 down saves the policies and re-apply restores those that still agree with the mapping. Drilled on a disposable database as iam_v2_owner: 269 of 269 mapped rows kept; 34 shared, 179 dedicated and 12 none restored exactly.
A database trigger refuses an older release's replace-with-one write against a shared policy (tested).

The room sign-in editor is a guided two-step flow with a recommended option, reasons for unavailable options, a plain-language sentence of the effect, a countdown for the shared selection, and a clear recovery when the routing changed after the preview.
